result.topic_en: Gauss sets up the circuit equations for induction experiments with two inductors (an induction coil and an induction wheel) and a multiplier, solving for the resistances and exciting forces from the observed effects and deriving the conditional equations that the observations must satisfy.
result.transcription:
209.
Inductionsversuche
Widerstand
1 im Multiplicator
r im ersten Erreger (Inductionsrolle)
R im zweiten Erreger Inductionsrad
Erregungskraft
e durch den ersten Erreger
$\mathfrak{E}$ durch den zweiten Erreger
Wirkungen
a, b, c | durch ersten Erreger |
A, B, C | zweiten | je nachdem der andere ausgeschlossen, oder ohne oder mit Theilung in der Kette ist.
Es ist dann
$a = \frac{e}{1+r}$ $\quad A = \frac{\mathfrak{E}}{1+R}$
$b = \frac{e}{1+r+R}$ $\quad B = \frac{\mathfrak{E}}{1+r+R}$
$c = \frac{eR}{r+R+Rr}$ $\quad C = \frac{\mathfrak{E}r}{r+R+Rr}$
Ferner
$aB + bA - aA = h$ gesetzt, also $h = \frac{e\mathfrak{E}}{(1+r)(1+R)(1+r+R)}$
$h = bB - (a-b)(A-B)$
$e = \frac{abA}{h}$ $\quad \mathfrak{E} = \frac{ABa}{h}$
$r = \frac{a(A-B)}{h}$ $\quad R = \frac{A(a-b)}{h}$
$1+r = \frac{bA}{h}$ $\quad 1+R = \frac{aB}{h}$
$1+r+R = \frac{aA}{h}$
Bedingungsgleichungen
$0 = abA + acA - abC - acB - bcA$
$0 = aAB + bAC - cAB - bAC - aBC$
oder
$ab(A-C) = ch$
$AB(a-c) = Ch$
Am besten
$\frac{R}{r} = \frac{a}{A}\cdot\frac{A-C}{a-c} = \frac{A}{a}\cdot\frac{a-b}{A-B} = \frac{Bc}{Cb}$
oder einfacher
$0 = \frac{A}{a} + \frac{B}{b} + \frac{C}{c} - \frac{A}{b} - \frac{A}{c}$
$0 = \frac{a}{A} + \frac{b}{B} + \frac{c}{C} - \frac{a}{B} - \frac{a}{C}$
oder
$0 = \frac{A}{a} - \frac{A-B}{b} - \frac{A-C}{c}$
$0 = \frac{a}{A} - \frac{a-b}{B} - \frac{a-c}{C}$

methods.what: Ohm's-law expressions for galvanometer currents from two inductors under three circuit configurations (other inductor excluded, in series, in parallel branch)
Definition of auxiliary quantity h and its expression in terms of EMFs and resistances
Solving for the exciting forces and resistances from observed effects
Total resistances in terms of observed effects
Conditional (consistency) equations among the six observations
